author: t. t. potter
title: Chanel Azong participates in Under Armour HBCU Career Combine in Baltimore
text:
Chanel Azong, a member of the women’s soccer team at Hampton University, participated in the fifth annual HBCU Career Combine sponsored by Under Armour, according to a June 10 announcement. The event took place at Under Armour’s headquarters in Baltimore from June 1 to 4.
The Career Combine is a selective program designed to give student-athletes exposure to global business practices with Under Armour and its partners. Participants spent several days learning about the business environment, developing critical thinking skills, and building leadership abilities as preparation for professional careers.
During the combine, participants were divided into teams and given assignments. Azong’s team finished second overall in the competition, earning her an Under Armour scholarship for the upcoming academic year.
Eligibility for the program required student-athletes to maintain a grade point average of 3.0 or higher, be students in good standing, have experience with campus or community involvement or employment history, and express career interests related to fashion/design, retail, sports, or business.
Azong is originally from Navan, Ireland. She attended Technological University of Dublin and played for Bohemian FC before joining Hampton University. In 2023, she contributed to her team’s semifinal appearance in the National Cup. She is also on the Hampton Dean’s List and has received Coastal Athletic Association Commissioner’s Honor Roll recognition with High Honors. As a midfielder for Hampton University’s women’s soccer team—the Pirates—she helped lead them to their most wins since 2015.
